units: <cite ref="Pesachim 31b:6">Pes. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>ומ׳ של נכרים</he> and the goods (in the store) belong to gentiles.
<cite ref="Tosefta Pesachim 1">Tosef. ib. I (II), 17</cite> <he>המ׳ של ישראל</he> if the goods belong to an Israelite.

<cite ref="Pesachim 53b:9">Pes. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>כל המטיל מ׳ לכיסוכ׳</he> one who throws the profits of merchandise into the purse of scholars, i.e., gives scholars an opportunity of gaining a livelihood.—

<cite ref="Shabbat 56a:3">Sabb. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ הטילו על בעלי בתים</he> they (the sons of Samuel) forced goods on private people (abused their station by making people their mercantile agents or their customers); <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 14:6">Tosef. Sot. XIV, 6</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 14:5">ib. 5</cite>; a. e.
